sections.title: GM14 Cam Profile
sections.text: Computes the pitch and roller working profiles from a rise law (halfCosine or samples) plus baseRadius and rollerRadius. The working profile is a normal offset by the roller radius, never a radial substitution. followerLine is the follower direction (default +Y); phase rotates the profile to align the follower. The rise-only CWG source stays open; release/dwell are unresolved and never closed by a chord or replaced by an eccentric.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result has schemaVersion:1, pitchProfile and workingProfile point arrays, rollerRadius, normalOffset, maxPressureAngle (deg), minPitchCurvatureRadius (mm), followerLine, phase, direction, resolvedIntervals, unresolvedIntervals and contact/separation notes.

examples.label: Half-cosine rise with R5 roller
examples.output: result.maxPressureAngle is about 10.96 deg and result.minPitchCurvatureRadius about 18.33 mm for these inputs.

sections.title: GM14 Cam Evaluation
sections.text: Evaluates pressure angle and pitch curvature against declared limits. minimumCurvatureRadius and maximumPressureAngle are optional; a missing limit is reported as notEvaluated, never as zero or pass. The rise-only CWG source is preserved without closure.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result has schemaVersion:1, maxPressureAngle (deg), minPitchCurvatureRadius (mm) and checks[] (curvature, pressure-angle) with pass/fail/notEvaluated per declared limit.

examples.label: Check pressure angle and curvature
examples.output: result.checks show pass for pressure-angle (10.96 < 12 deg) and curvature (18.33 > 10 mm).

sections.title: GM14 Cam Cycle Resolution
sections.text: Resolves cam cycle intervals and flags unresolved dwell/release. The rise-only CWG source leaves release unresolved unless an explicit law (release, returnLaw) is supplied. No chord closure, eccentric substitution or forced bilateral follower coupling during release. Drop edge and dynamics remain blocked until properly defined.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result has schemaVersion:1, resolvedIntervals, unresolvedIntervals, closure note, followerCoupling, dropEdgeDynamics and cycleStatus (pass when nothing unresolved, else unknown).

examples.label: Rise with spring return
examples.output: result.cycleStatus is pass; release is resolved by the declared spring return law.
